svg.title: IoTbase NANO overview
svg.desc: IoTbase NANO — carrier board for Arduino Nano form-factor modules
svg.text: Carrier board for Arduino Nano form-factor modules · IoTextra mezzanine · mikroBUS™ · EYESPI (LCD)
Power: 9–36 VDC or USB · RS485 · 1-Wire · Qwiic · GPIO and I²C · Open Hardware
Part of the IoTbase series · compatible with IoTextra mezzanine modules · Make Things Happy!
